prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1090; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection. Our client was struck by a vehicle insured under your policy while proceeding through the intersection. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you disclose the full bodily injury liability limits of the policy covering the at-fault driver, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also provide a copy of the declarations page in force on the date of loss.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, claim notes, repair estimates, and any salvage or damaged vehicle components. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect these materials.

Kindly acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm in writing that the requested preservation steps have been taken. We look forward to your prompt response.
